data.one_liner: Material Design responsive layout grid implementation for adaptive UIs across screen sizes.
data.what_it_does: It helps create dynamic, adaptive grid layouts that seamlessly adjust to various screen sizes and orientations. It implements Material Design's responsive layout grid with customizable gutters, margins, and column span cells.
use_when: You need to build responsive layouts following Material Design grid specifications.
You want to display different child widgets depending on small or large screen widths.
You need visual debugging overlays to inspect column grids and gutters.
avoid_when: You are looking for state management or dependency injection tools.
You need complex physics-based animations or charting components.
strengths: Implements standard Material Design responsive layout grid.
Includes helpful centered layout constructors and screen width adaptive widgets.
Provides a visual debugging overlay for columns and gutters.
weaknesses: Limited to grid layouts and screen width adaptations.
Early version (0.0.3) with a minimal feature set.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive suite for scaling and adapting UIs across various device sizes automatically.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers builder widgets to easily handle different screen sizes and breakpoints declaratively.

data.minimal_example:
WoltResponsiveLayoutGrid(
  isOverlayVisible: true,
  gutter: 16,
  margin: 32,
  columnSpanCells: [
    WoltColumnSpanCell(
      columnCellWidget: Placeholder(color: Colors.blue, strokeWidth: 4),
      columnSpan: 4,
    ),
  ],
)
